# bizz.bg - Business Listings in Bulgaria


bizz.bg is an online platform in Bulgaria dedicated to connecting buyers and sellers of businesses.
Launched in 2025, its mission is to create a transparent and efficient marketplace for business transactions.
The platform was started by two entrepreneurs who identified a need for a specialized portal for buying and selling businesses in the Bulgarian market.

Key features and statistics of bizz.bg include:

Over 5000 registered users
More than 1200 active listings
Facilitates over 40 successful deals monthly
A team of professionals with experience in various industries
The platform offers various types of listings, including:

Buying and selling businesses
Franchise opportunities
Business properties for sale, such as a commercial property in Svoge with potential for a hotel, restaurant, or educational center.
Services, like an offer to become a leader in Econt (a courier company) by managing offices, or the sale of an established luxury beauty studio in Varna.
Selling business ideas, such as a concept for translation and editing services or an AI-driven online trading website.
Seeking financing for projects.
bizz.bg also provides articles, information about listing types, and contact details.
The platform emphasizes user safety, advising users to verify legal documents, visit businesses in person, check financial statements, and consult with lawyers before making deals.

Key public pages:

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](http://bizz.bg/): Browse and search active business ads for Bulgaria.
- [About Us](http://bizz.bg/about/): Learn more about bizz.bg
- [Contact Us](http://bizz.bg/contact/): Get in touch with support.
- [Terms of Service](http://bizz.bg/terms-of-service/): Read the terms of service.
- [Privacy Policy](http://bizz.bg/privacy-policy/): Understand how we handle your data.
